import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p = params
    n = p[0] + p[1]*T + p[2]*T**2
    K = p[3] + p[4]*T + p[5]*T**2
    return K*eps**n + p[6] + p[7]*T

import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p = params
    n = p[0] + p[1]*T
    K = np.exp(p[2] + p[3]*T + p[4]*T**2)
    e0 = p[5] + p[6]*T
    return K*(eps + np.abs(e0))**n

import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p = params
    s0 = p[0] + p[1]*T + p[2]*T**2
    Q = p[3] + p[4]*T
    b = p[5] + p[6]*T
    return s0 + Q*(1-np.exp(-b*eps)) + p[7]*eps

import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p = params
    L = np.log(1 + eps)
    S = np.sqrt(T)
    z = p[0] + p[1]*S + p[2]*T + p[3]*T**2 + (p[4] + p[5]*T + p[6]*S)*L + (p[7] + p[8]*T)*L**2 + p[9]*L**3
    return np.exp(z)
